On Wed, Jul 27, 2022 at 12:56 AM Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey Vera (I dropped Adam and Johnny from this thread, added Laura because of INSPIRES, and Nils from
RDMA),
I just had a call with RDMA and Internews today regarding the potential collaboration with YouTube as an add-or
to a newly awarded program that will work with journalists and creators that are reporting on disinformation in the
region.
Next week, Internews is aiming to come back to us with a concept and budget, which I assume we can
present to YouTube for discussion.
Let me know if we're OK with that --I'm happy to participate from Belgrade - which is actually a convenient spot
to talk both to Asia and DC.
Best,
Josh
